snippet.title: The Void | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Void is a wave based survival horror fps inspired by the movie "The Mist" and spiritual theology. Your objective is to survive by utilizing the scarce resources and fighting through the hordes of creatures. Survive the Void, and find Absolution

The Void is developed by Jeffy Zachariah from Kerala, India.

Wishlist now on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4513750/The_Void/
